payload.text: The About page is one HTML document: a Content-Security-Policy that comes before anything it governs and allows no source but the page's own styles, data: images and the images the app serves; then the default stylesheet, which follows light and dark mode; then the app's stylesheet, which cannot end its style element; then each refusal, escaped for HTML, masthead.yaml's before the About files'; then the body. A token in the body's HTML that names no value the app gives is refused, naming the token and the values there are, on the page and in the app's log; a Markdown link's address holds no token, since cmark-gfm encodes its braces.
